subject: Nariway Signals - 2026-09-10 - Beyoncé's quiet gift, and a bequest fight cutting both ways
html:
Nariway Signals
Thursday, September 10, 2026
Lead
Beyoncé gave the Studio Museum in Harlem $2M on her own birthday, a year into its new $300M home
The gift landed Sept 4, her 45th birthday, with a statement crediting the museum's exhibitions for introducing her to "several of my favorite young and upcoming Black artists." It's a major living patron putting real money behind an institution she didn't have to build herself.
A useful counterweight to the founder-museum pattern this brief tracks constantly — Lucas, Faro Santander, Dib Bangkok — arriving just under a year after the Studio Museum's own from-scratch rebuild opened: a collector-patron choosing to reinforce an existing, already-public institution rather than start a new one.
ARTnews  ·  The Art Newspaper  ·  Artnet
What's happening
The Speed Art Museum has named Kathleen V. Jameson its next director, a year ahead of its 2027 centennial
Jameson — a scholar of late-19th/early-20th-century American photography and works on paper, most recently director of Pennsylvania's Michener Art Museum, and once the Speed's own directorial intern in 1995 — started Sept 8. Another entry in the museum-leadership churn this brief has tracked for weeks, this one landing with an unusually concrete stake: whoever runs the Speed now sets its acquisition and donor strategy for the centennial year immediately ahead.
ARTnews  ·  Louisville Public Media
Law & estates
Two donor-intent bequest fights, landing on opposite sides of the same question
A Dutch court ruled in June that the Mauritshuis does not have to return a 25-painting bequest — including works attributed to Rembrandt and Jan Steen — to the heirs of former director Abraham Bredius, finding the museum had properly honored the bequest's own conditions. Orlando Museum of Art is the fresh instance running the other way: per WealthManagement.com's Trusts & Estates desk, the museum is now challenging the intended purpose of one of its own donor's bequests. Together they're the two live shapes a bequest dispute takes — a museum defending its reading of donor intent, and a museum contesting it — exactly the fact pattern an estate attorney structuring a gift-with-conditions needs both sides of.
The Art Newspaper  ·  WealthManagement.com
For the record
The Artists' Legacy Foundation named Mildred Howard its 2026 Artist Award winner
The award, anonymously nominated and juried, has distributed $450,000-plus to painters and sculptors since 2007 — a modest but genuinely working example of the artist-endowed legacy vehicle this brief otherwise tracks mostly at the collector-museum end.
Artists' Legacy Foundation

Public preview Sept 11–14, sale Sept 15, 20 Rockefeller Plaza; already on Alina's calendar for the Sept 12 preview. ARTnews

Public-view legs: Paris Sept 9–12, New York Sept 17–20, Hong Kong Sept 25–29, London from Oct 8, sale Oct 14 (£20–30M / $27–41M estimate). ARTnews

"Le goût Rothschild en héritage" — public preview Sept 17–22, sale Sept 22, Paris. Artcurial
